mcp_identity.encoding: E(x) = percent-encode each UTF-8 byte except ASCII ALPHA/DIGIT/-._~, uppercase hex; never trim, case-fold, Unicode-normalize, decode or numerically coerce IDs. Reject empty/whitespace/control source IDs and inputs >256 characters. Encoded keys may exceed source-ID length.
mcp_identity.observation_id: fresh UUID per bridge collection, retained for retries of that exact payload only
mcp_identity.run_id: Opaque n8n-run:{execution_id}:{uuid_v4}; one terminal outcome per execution, observation_id binds immutable data.
mcp_identity.observation_child_key: {observation_id}:{E(table)}:{E(component1)}:...; fixed arity per table; optional components use nullable_key_components tags; ordinal components are canonical base-10 nonnegative integers and local to observation only
mcp_identity.nullable_key_components: Encode absent optional child-key component as literal ~null and present components as ~value followed by E(value); this discriminates an absent warning entity from any real ID. Fixed table key arity; no delimiter ambiguity.

mcp_numeric_policy.ingestion: Decimal constructed directly from bounded strings; no float intermediate; validate lexical length before parsing; preserve exact value; reject malformed/non-finite/out-of-range without truncation or rounding
mcp_numeric_policy.absence: absent/null unknown, zero is known; reject booleans, blanks and text placeholders as amounts
mcp_numeric_policy.sheets: Monetary, quantity and rate columns use exact decimal TEXT written RAW; nullable cells explicitly clear using empty strings. Manual allocation targets use decimal fractions and manual cashflows use EUR.
mcp_numeric_policy.simulation: Declared numeric tool inputs/outputs are separate approximate on-demand results; enforce finite JSON numbers and explicit bounds before invocation. Never use as ingestion decimals.
mcp_numeric_policy.equality: Compare validated decimal strings by exact numeric value, never lexical spelling or binary floats. No canonical scale: 0, 0.00 and -0.00 are equal; 250.0 and 250.00 are equal. Preserve source spelling in stored decimal text; equality does not round or relax lexical bounds.
mcp_numeric_policy.precision: Preserve exact decimal text up to 24 integer and 64 fractional digits. These are project safety bounds, not a verified upstream maximum; values outside them fail without rounding.

states.PARTIAL: Collection COMPLETE, at least one row has both amount and currency and at least one does not.
states.UNAVAILABLE: Collection is not COMPLETE, or its nonempty accepted rows contain no known amount/currency pair.
